dating_and_relationships.chronological_effect: Earlier Greek praise reporting makes bet-source hypothesis serious; not an automatic priority override. Do not give Ecclesiastes the Pentateuch's third-century-BCE translation date, equate CAL selected text to a dated copy, or infer ancient bet spelling from modern editions.

arguments.bet_support: Actual published Hebrew bet attestation; distinct Greek/Latin praise; local Greek maps forget vs praise differently;8:11-14 show delayed punishment and inverted fortunes.
arguments.bet_objection: Later bet copies may absorb al-tiqre interpretation; Greek/Latin possible interpretation or shared ancestry; passive Greek versus reflexive Hebrew remains a separate translation issue; full modern target apparatus absent.
arguments.kaf_support: Actual WLC and selected Syriac/Targum forgetting;2:16/9:5 make postmortem oblivion native to book.
arguments.kaf_objection: Forget is difficult immediately before delayed-punishment passage; kaf/bet confusion could alter a prior boast/praise reading, but no observed ancient conversion proves the direction.
arguments.transmission: De Rossi proposes possible Talmudic contamination of many late copies while Greek suggests an earlier alternative. Record as his argued hypothesis, not proved cause. Nearby8:15 assimilation is an additional unproved possibility.
arguments.subject_and_timing: Currentsame-subject wording is one interpretation. Buried wicked then praise is possible postmortem reception; boast requires earlier action. Alternative subject shift to upright people is not ruled out by targetlexeme alone.
arguments.counterfactual_age: Without earlier Greek reporting, bet remains directly reported but later and correction/reception-sensitive. Chronology increases interest, not enough by itself to select exact consonants or English.

decisions.historical_working_preference: Pending one exact review; retain declared WLC provisionally. Materialize bet/boast alternative without substituting a note-only application.

reopen: Moderntargetapparatus and identified manuscript correction states/dates/relationships, or a discriminating transmission/grammar argument. More model agreement on unchanged inputs is not evidence.
